proposed_replacement.rationale: Jinja2 is the preferred templating engine for Python and is widely used in the community.

migration_steps.title: Update Jinja2 to use soft_unicode
migration_steps.description: Jinja2's soft_unicode has been deprecated and removed. Update the import to use the new version.
migration_steps.diff_snippet:
from jinja2 import Environment
# Update to use soft_unicode
env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(template_dir()), autoescape=select_autoescape(['html', 'j2']))

suggested_tests.description: Verify that the templating engine renders all sites correctly
suggested_tests.code_snippet:
import pytest
from jinja2 import Environment
# Create a new environment
env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(''), autoescape=select_autoescape(['html', 'j2']))
# Render a template
template = env.from_string('<html>Hello World!</html>')
assert template == '<html>Hello World!</html>'

compatibility_gaps.description: MarkupSafe has been removed and no longer supports soft_unicode.
compatibility_gaps.mitigation: Upgrade MarkupSafe to >=3.1.2,<4.0.0 to ensure compatibility.

open_concerns_and_limitations.title: No other alternatives
open_concerns_and_limitations.description: No other templating engines are widely used in the community, making Jinja2 the best choice.
